title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1995 Drew Barrymore Amber Smith + 1 Bonus Magazine VTG
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 original vintage Playboy magazines from 1995 featuring Drew Barrymore, Amber Smith, Victoria Jacobs and Playmate of the Year Julie Lynn Cialini.

January 1995 – Drew Barrymore
Holiday Anniversary Issue featuring Drew Barrymore. Also includes the Playboy Interview with Jean-Claude Van Damme, Melissa Holliday as Playmate of the Month, the 1994 Playmate Review and other features. 

February 1995 – Fabulous at 40
Victoria Jacobs cover featuring Playboy’s “Fabulous at 40” pictorial. Includes Lisa Marie Scott as Playmate of the Month, a Playboy Interview with Tim Robbins and Playboy’s international survey. 

March 1995 – Amber Smith
Supermodel Amber Smith cover and pictorial photographed by Bert Stern. Includes Stacy Sanches as Playmate of the Month and additional interviews and features. 

June 1995 – Playmate of the Year
Features Julie Lynn Cialini, Playboy’s 1995 Playmate of the Year. Also includes Rhonda Adams as Playmate of the Month, 20 Questions with Tom Arnold, a Russ Meyer pictorial salute, Hot Cars of 1995 and other features. 

All four are original vintage issues with UPC/barcodes visible on the covers.

Pre-owned vintage condition with normal signs of age, storage and handling. Covers show some light surface wear, edge/corner wear and occasional marks. Overall they appear to display nicely for approximately 30-year-old magazines.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.

Great collectible group for Playboy collectors and fans of Drew Barrymore, Amber Smith, 1990s celebrities and vintage entertainment magazines.
